page.overview:
Who is Tripp Yates?

Tripp Yates was approached by the Prisoner at Helius Gate. They asked him what the Sandflies had tasked him to recover from the wreck of the Kytherea. He replied that it was only medical supplies, but when pressed he admitted that he did not know what was in the cargo. He revealed that an individual known as the Red Scorpion had ordered the Sandlies to send him to transport the cargo with discretion. He then told them that it was rumored that the cargo was being sought by crime lords, spies and Imperials and that the Red Scorpion could be found at an old testing station.
